title.narrative: Emergency Response to Super Typhoon Pepito

description.narrative: IOM, and its partners, will provide emergency assistance to vulnerable displaced people to preserve lives and maintain dignified living conditions. The project includes Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM), Shelter and multi-purpose cash assistance (MPCA) to displaced persons, returnees and community members in communities and collective sites. IOM and implementing partners will: 1. Provide CCCM technical support to the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) and other national authorities, in targeted communities and collective displacement sites, which will also include facilitating and needs assessments; technical assistance; and establishing consultation mechanisms with affected populations. 2. Provide Shelter assistance to the most vulnerable households with damaged houses through the provision of shelter fixing kits (SFKs), which will be complemented by cash-for-shelter and build back safer (BBS) trainings. 3. Finally, the most vulnerable households will also receive MPCA assistance to cover their immediate needs. Interventions will tentatively focus on the following municipalities (although the final locations will be determined based on assessed needs and in coordination with clusters, Government partners and other humanitarian partners during implementation) Abulug, Pamplona, Sta. Teresita, Gonzaga, Sta. Ana, and Aparri municipalities of Cagayan provinces; Echague and Angadanan municipalities of Isabela Province; Casiguran, Dipaculao, and Dilasag municipalities of Aurora provinces; and Virac, Caramoran, Viga, Pandan, Bagamanoc, San Miguel, Panganiban and Gigmoto municipalities of Catanduanes.
